info.name: ShieldTB Backend
info.description: Generated from the ShieldTB OpenAPI schema. Use the Postman Desktop Agent for localhost requests. Run Health check first, then Sign up or Log in to populate token variables.

request.description: Simple liveness endpoint for local development and deployment probes.
Returns active facilities matching a name or facility code for account signup.
Creates a non-admin user account. Browser clients default to HttpOnly JWT cookies; native clients may request `auth_mode: "token"` to receive tokens in the body.
Authenticates a user. Browser clients default to HttpOnly JWT cookies; native clients may request `auth_mode: "token"` to receive tokens in the body.
Rotates the refresh token. Browser clients default to updated HttpOnly cookies; native clients may request `auth_mode: "token"` to receive fresh tokens in the body.
Revokes the current access token and blacklists the refresh token when provided.
